subtitles.en: So it sort of seems like by now, pay later, you don't necessarily have to deal with how good your credit score is, the way that you might if you get a credit card. So it kind of
subtitles.zh: 先买后付服务似乎不像信用卡那样看重信用评分，

subtitles.en: is a way that people who maybe don't have the best credit score to get credit and private banking, shadow banking, also seems like a way for companies that also might not have the best credit
subtitles.zh: 为信用评分不高的人提供了获取信贷的途径。私人信贷和影子银行也类似，

subtitles.en: or might be maybe wanting to take out riskier loans for something that is maybe a little riskier.
subtitles.zh: 为信用不佳或寻求高风险贷款的公司提供资金。

subtitles.en: It seems like a way that they can get money. So this seems like two services that are a little bit similar in that way. Is that right? Yeah, definitely. I mean, in terms of the appeal for
subtitles.zh: 这两种服务似乎有相似之处，对吗？确实如此。

subtitles.en: a private credit manager with, you know, take the forward flows, right, which we dig into in the story, these are ways that the private credit manager can get access to a steady, you know,
subtitles.zh: 对私人信贷管理者而言，远期流动协议能提供稳定、可预测的短期资产流，

subtitles.en: predictable stream of short-term assets, right? Which is sort of outside of the realm of the typical longer term debt that might sit on their books from the by now pay later firms perspective.
subtitles.zh: 这不同于他们通常持有的长期债务。

subtitles.en: Rather than them waiting for payments to come back in so that they can get capital and extend more loans, they have willing buyers on the private credit side that say, hey, you know, we'll give you
subtitles.zh: 先买后付公司无需等待回款，私人信贷方会提供资金，

subtitles.en: that capital. You focus on what you're good at. You focus on extending those loans on helping everyday consumers make these purchases happen.
subtitles.zh: 让他们专注于发放贷款，帮助消费者完成购买。
